correctness.rationale: PBW reductions yield basis {1,x,y,xy,y²,xy²} and product (x^u y^v)(x^u′ y^v′)=λ^(v u′)x^(u+u′)y^(v+v′). Since automorphisms preserve the local radical, x-image initially has possible y-linear term b, but the y² coefficient of X² is b², hence b=0 over any field and cotangent invertibility requires ag≠0. I independently multiplied the five positive-degree basis elements symbolically, confirming X²=ad(1+λ²)xy², Y³=fg²(1+λ+λ²)xy² and YX−λXY=(λ−1)[a i λ−df(1+λ+λ²)]xy². The Y³ condition kills df, and the three scalar equations are necessary and sufficient for all defining relations. A filtered endomorphism invertible on m/m² is surjective on the associated graded algebra and hence the finite local algebra. The free parameter count gives the reduced variety and all finite-field orders; at λ=1 in characteristics 2 or 3 exactly two resonances produce dimension eight. This is a variety classification, not a claim that the group scheme is reduced.
residual_risks: The finite computations do not establish the unrestricted theorem; the argument in the pinned RESULT.md supplies the universal quantifiers.
